page.layout: One page of text, centred short paragraphs; running head at top with page number at top right; signature mark at bottom left.

main_text.p: spatium. Et alia sequerentur absurda quae consideranti patebunt.

Opponis. In vacuo nullum adesset medium resistens; ergo motus fieret in instanti. Venit sero argumentum; vidimus enim successionem motus non enasci a medio, sed a virtute limitata mobilis, & a distantia extremorum in spatio. Recolite dicta.
main_text.head: Finis Sexti Libri.

page.notes: Scan is faint in places; the catchword-like mark "LI" at the foot is read as a signature. Several words at line ends are hyphenated in print and have been joined without hyphen where the break is clear; a few marginal ornaments and show-through are omitted.
